data.name: Hideout Automation
data.teaser: This mod automates hideout crafting, constructions, upgrades and installations. Stack crafts. Optionally choose which requirements to skip. FIKA is supported.
data.description:
Tired of spending too much time in menus?

New Features (Experimental):

  • (Crafting) Production stacking (Queue multiple productions) When one finishes, the next starts automatically.
  • Requirements are paid upfront when stacking.
  • Automation only runs while in-game (and not in raid).
  • Tools are only required once for the full production stack.
  • Automatically moves produced items to stash.
  • Stack button instead of Start button.
  • Shows stacked amount and total amount in production.

This mod automates several hideout-related action to streamline your experience:

  • Automatically construct when requirements are met (default: on)
  • Automatically upgrade when requirements are met (default: on)
  • Automatically install construction or upgrade when completed (default: on)
  • Use a dialog window to accept the costs and requirements of the construction or upgrade (default: on)

Tyfon-HideoutInProgress (HIP)

  • (Experimental) HIP mod support. If you have HIP mod installed the HideoutAutomation mod will automate the contributions to HIP.
  • (Option) to enable the automated contributions to HIP. When disabled the mod wont do anything for HIP.
  • (Option) to only contribute when Area Requirements are met. (default: on) When enabled, automated contributions are made only after all required items are collected. Partial amounts will no longer be contributed.

Remove requirements

  • Inspired by the Skipper mod by Terkoiz (for tasks), the mod adds the ability to automatically remove requirements of the construction or upgrade costs.

You can toggle the following requirements types: (all default to on)

  • Remove other area requirements.
  • Remove currency* requirements.
  • Remove skill requirements.
  • Remove trader requirements.
  • Remove item requirements. *currency requirements are: Rubles, Dollars and Euros. Switching these settings pops up a dialog for your game to reload so the hideout shows the correct requirements.

Usage

The mod starts working from the start of the game.

Installation:

  1. Download the mod file using the button above.
  2. Open the downloaded archive.
  3. Drag the BepInEx folder into your SPT installation directory.

Planned Features:

  • Ideas are welcome.

Known Issues:

  • No known issues at this time.

Limitations:

  • No known limitations at this time.

Compatibility:

  • No known conflicts with other mods.
  • FIKA is now supported.

Recommended Mods:

  • Task automation

versions.description:
Features:
- Added option to enable/disable the (experimental) production stacking feature.

A better implementation will be released SOON™.

Fixes:
- Patched HideoutController.UpgradeComplete to check if stage level exists before setting it.
- Added check if area was constructing to prevent level going up to max when not intended on client glitch.
- **Added logic to fix player profiles that got bugged out by allowing levels higher then max level.**
- Prevent "Unable to edit a traders item" message from throwing.
- Finally found a way to hard refresh the draw of SimpleStashPanel. So contributed items will disappear preventing the game from breaking. 
- Changed from Last in First out to First in First out for productions stacks.
- Added check to see if a production (still) exists in the profile. Preventing the "Unable to find production recipe" message.

Please report any bugs or problems you encounter by creating an issue here: https://github.com/PMouse23/SPT-HideoutAutomation/issues

Fixes (Tyfon-HideoutInProgress (HIP) mod support):
- Fixed an issue where contributions were made before the backend was aware of the item.
- Fixed so that all required contributions must be made before starting the construction or upgrade of an area.

Fixes: (Craft stacking)
- Temporarily disabled tool payment. Tools must still be present in inventory to start or stack a recipe, but they are no longer consumed. This will be reimplemented in a future update.

Fixes:
- Fixed Water Collector lvl3 bugging out with purified water craft active.
- Fixed several *reported* and unreported exception errors. Thanks for the reports this has been helping me a lot! 

More fixes soon. Please report any bugs or problems you encounter by creating an issue here: https://github.com/PMouse23/SPT-HideoutAutomation/issues

A bit more playable as the previous version.

Fixes:
- Only count area productions that are not continuous.
- Keep original non stacking logic for continuous schemes.
- Do not auto receive continuous schemes. This is causing some weird issues. I might add this back as a option later.

More fixes soon. Please report any bugs or problems you encounter by creating an issue here: https://github.com/PMouse23/SPT-HideoutAutomation/issues

Fixes:
- Fixed a bug with Tyfon-HideoutInProgress (HIP) mod support by recognizing the old (2.0.0) and new (2.1.0+) GUID of the HIP mod.
- Fixed Stopping the Coroutine that checks for hideout updates while going into raid.

New Features (Experimental):
- Production stacking (**Queue multiple productions**) When one finishes, the next starts automatically.
- _Requirements are paid upfront when stacking._
- _Automation only runs while in-game (and not in raid)._
- _Tools are only required once for the full production stack._
- Automatically moves **produced items to stash**.
- **Stack button** instead of Start button.
- Shows stacked amount and total amount in production.

I started working on this in mid-October. After a lot of tweaking and a complete restart about two weeks ago. I’ve finally made a **playtest-ready version**. It was quite challenging to get everything right while solving multiple issues along the way, so please report any bugs or problems you encounter by creating an issue here: https://github.com/PMouse23/SPT-HideoutAutomation/issues

New Features / Options:
- (Experimental) [Tyfon-HideoutInProgress (HIP)](https://forge.sp-tarkov.com/mod/2076/hideout-in-progress) mod support. If you have HIP mod installed the hideoutautomation mod will automate the contributions to HIP.
- (Option) to disable the automated contributions to HIP.
- (Option) to only contribute when Area Requirements are met. (default: **on**)

Let me know if you find some bugs or missing features.
